name: Giant Propel Advanced SL 1 (Gen 4)
why_interesting: A current official mainland page now resolves the exact fourth-generation Propel Advanced SL 1 trim, CNY 54,800 suggested price and Ultegra Di2 BOM. Official Giant testing supplies protocol-backed frame and fork stiffness values.
missing: Mainland-delivered complete-bike weight and weighing basis; 6.8 kg size S is an exact official Japan trim reference
Current mainland stock, selected size/color, final checkout and dealer warranty handling

facts.frame: Advanced SL-grade composite frame and Advanced SL full-composite fork
facts.complete_weight_reference: 6.8 kg in size S on the official Japan page for the same named 2027 trim; the mainland page does not publish complete-bike weight
facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra Di2 electronic hydraulic 2x12 with 11-34T cassette and 52/36T Giant Power Pro power-meter crank
facts.frame_stiffness_evidence: Giant manufacturer protocol fixes the dropouts and dummy fork, inclines the frame 10 degrees and applies force at the pedal eye; values are manufacturer testing rather than independent lab results

support_note: Giant provides an official mainland dealer locator and warranty policy; neither establishes current fourth-generation Propel trim stock or price.
source_note: Current official mainland evidence resolves the exact trim, CNY 54,800 suggested price and Ultegra Di2 BOM. Official Japan supplies a 6.8 kg size-S reference, and Giant publishes protocol-backed manufacturer stiffness values. Regional weight caveat remains explicit.
